notes.title: v1.15 Out Now
notes.content:
Version 1.15 is now available with a bunch of tweaks and fixes. Thanks to everyone who has supported this game throughout the years and has shown enormous patience with this update! 

-Fixed a memory leak (Access Violation Error)
-Fixed slow Contract screen
-Fixed skipping of post-match messages
-Fixed freekick rating when scoring a freekick
-Tweaked short and long pass ratings
-Removed starting club choice
-Ban length shown on next fixture info
-Injury length shown on next fixture info
-Headers aim automatically on simple control scheme
-Fewer sub appearances required at start of your International career
-Reduced chance of late substitution time
-Increased player transfer values
-Decreased dribbling speed
-Reduced opponent skill in training challenges
-Reduced slide velocity
-Time taken to get up from a slide depends on tackling skill
-Boss not negative about failed crosses
-Boss not negative about failed headers
-Tidied up some boss comments
-Removed flags from match scoreline

notes.title: Dini And The Wonderkids: A History Of Football Games
notes.content:
FOOTBALL. It’s been on your telly for the last few weeks and it’s staying there for a few weeks more. FOOTBALL. Every supermarket is full of products adorned with the looming faces of men who kick balls for a living. FOOTBALL. It’s only gone and found its way onto RPS as well.

The World Cup comes but once every four years and it’s a time of celebration and eventual heartbreak for many, and numbing ennui for many more. In honour of the tournament so far, which has been refreshingly full of goals and only the occasional nil-nil draw or shoulder-chomp, I’ve written a brief but definitive history of football games.

notes.title: Now Available - New Star Soccer 5
notes.content:
New Star Soccer 5 is now available on Steam and is available for 10% off*!

Live the life of an up-and-coming superstar in this unique football career game. Start out as a 16 year old lad and work your way to the top to become a footballing legend!

Discount ends October 4th at 10am Pacific Time.
